description: Repo-scale (axum-bookclub): add pagination to GET /api/clubs/:id/books that must compose with the existing status filter, not bypass it
prompts: Add pagination to `GET /api/clubs/:club_id/books`: accept `page` (1-based, default 1) and `page_size` (default 20, max 100) query parameters, both positive integers - reject with 400 otherwise. The response body changes shape to `{ books, total, page, pageSize }`, where `books` is just that page's slice and `total` is the count of ALL matching books (not just the page). Pagination must be applied AFTER the existing `status` filter, not before - `total` must reflect the filtered count, and the returned `books` must be the correct page of the FILTERED result set.

reference_solution.Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "axum_bookclub"
version = "0.2.0"
edition = "2021"

[lib]
name = "axum_bookclub"
path = "src/lib.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "axum_bookclub"
path = "src/main.rs"

[dependencies]
axum = "0.7"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"

[dev-dependencies]
tower = { version = "0.5", features = ["util"] }
http-body-util = "0.1"
